lines.text: Timothy is charged before God and Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, to preach the word.
People will not tolerate sound doctrine, so they will gather teachers to suit their desires and turn aside to idols.
Timothy is told to endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill his ministry.
The writer is being poured out like a drink offering, having fought the good fight and finished the race.
The crown of righteousness awaits the writer and all who crave the Lord's temple.
